cues.zh: 可以看到，我利用對函數已有的認識，測試一些假設，找出額外的臨界點。

cues.en: If you came up with a different solution and you would like to share it with your fellow calculus students, then feel free to post that to the Q&A.
cues.zh: 如果有不同解法，想和其他微積分學員分享，歡迎貼到問答區。

cues.en: So that's the end of this code challenge.
cues.zh: 這次程式挑戰就到這裡。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed it.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡。

cues.en: You learn lots of super interesting things here.
cues.zh: 學到了很多非常有趣的東西。

cues.en: You learn how to estimate critical points in NumPy and also how to compute critical points in some pie,
cues.zh: 學會如何在 NumPy 估計臨界點，也學會如何在 SymPy 計算，

cues.en: but also that you cannot just naively rely on using simply to test for where the derivative equals zero requires a little bit more thought than that.
cues.zh: 同時知道，不能只是天真依賴 SymPy，測試導數何時等於零，還需要多思考一點。
